# Stigande royaltyintäkter för Bioarctic – Vad väntar för Nvidia?

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (26 Aug 2026) with guest John Hernander of AMF looks ahead to Nvidia's report that evening as a gauge of AI sentiment going into 2027, and questions analysts' sharply raised semiconductor and memory estimates, with Micron singled out for cyclicality risk. BioArctic's CEO says Leqembi royalties and the Eli Lilly brain-transporter deal are going well, and Handelsbanken auto analyst Hampus Engellau expects Volvo Cars volumes to recover in the second half on new models, although price competition is tough and Chinese carmakers are gaining share in Europe. Falling oil prices and interest rates, plus data-center orders for Skanska and Bravida, gave a mildly positive tone to the Stockholm market.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 APP — AppLovin | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

AMF (guest John Hernander) has started building a position in its global portfolio after the guidance-driven share-price collapse.

#### Reasoning

Guest fund manager view. The business performs very well operationally, with strong growth, about 80% gross margins and a strong position in mobile-game ads, and is expanding into e-commerce. The market expected results too early and a small guidance cut crashed the stock. The SEC probe overhang is gone. It is volatile and a long-term investment, not one to put all your savings in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the e-commerce expansion fails to gain traction
- if guidance is cut again
- if regulatory or privacy scrutiny comes back

> *"App-loving är ett bolag som vi har börjat doppa tårna lite grann i på den globala portföljen."*

---

### 🟢 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Handelsbanken analyst Hampus Engellau is confident on volumes, says the stock is more interesting two years out, and names Volvo his favourite among European automakers.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view. H2 volumes should pick up on EX60, the refreshed EX30 and EX90, and ES90. The SPA3 platform is competitive and Geely cooperation raises product ambitions. Risks: tough price competition that squeezes margins, the CTO leaving, and weakness in China.

#### Sell Triggers

- if H2 volume growth fails to show up
- if price competition hurts margins further
- if the tech-leadership change disrupts the platform roadmap

> *"Men på de här nivåerna, om man tittar två år ut, så tycker jag absolut att då kanske aktien är lite mer intressant."*

---

### 🟡 HM-B — H&M | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken lowered its recommendation from buy to hold; the stock is among the day's weakest.

#### Reasoning

Cited broker downgrade (Handelsbanken, buy to hold) reported by the hosts; no reasons were given in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow
- if sales momentum weakens

> *"Där har man fått en sänkt rekommendation från Handelsbanken som sänker från köp till behåll."*

---

### ⛔ VOW3 — Volkswagen | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The analyst ranks Volkswagen as the most troubled European carmaker; it is under pressure from Chinese competitors.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Engellau) ranking puts VW at the bottom. It is pushing for tariffs on Chinese plug-in hybrids because it feels squeezed, and Chinese market share in Europe has doubled to about 10% in 18 months.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU tariffs on Chinese PHEVs meaningfully protect VW's market share

> *"Om man ska rangordna dem, kan jag säga att Folke har mest problem."*

---

### 🟠 BIOA-B — BioArctic | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q2 beat expectations, Leqembi royalties are growing and the Lilly platform deal validates the brain transporter; the stock rose 4%.

#### Reasoning

CEO interview plus host commentary, all positive but with no explicit buy call. The brain-transporter platform deals (about $770m in milestones plus royalties), the US approval of subcutaneous Leqembi and the Parkinson's phase 2b plans are catalysts. Leqembi growth of only about 10% is a caveat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Leqembi royalty growth stalls
- if the Parkinson's program fails to advance to phase 2b
- if Lilly milestones are delayed

> *"Så att ytterligare ett stort bolag, och nu Eli Lilly väljer vår teknologi framför alla andra som finns i världen är jättestort och viktigt för oss."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

The report tonight is a bellweather for AI; forward-looking comments matter more than the quarter's numbers.

#### Reasoning

Guest (AMF) says the key points are the next-generation ramp, China volumes, the 15% price increase and the risks of customer financing. The stock has fallen on recent beats, and competitors (AMD, Marvell, OpenAI's chip) have caught up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if guidance disappoints
- if customer-financing risks grow
- if competitors take share

> *"Det är en stor rapport som blir en bellweather för AI-temperaturen under andra halvåret."*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Estimates have surged on the memory shortage, but the guest warns of cyclicality as capacity expands and a Chinese competitor enters.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: 2026 and 2027 EPS estimates are up about 450% and about 1000%. Supply and demand should converge, so the price tailwind will probably change, and long contracts cover only part of sales. Analysts are stretching out-year estimates to justify valuations.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices roll over
- if capacity additions create oversupply

> *"Så att priskomponenten som har drivit en stor del av vinstförväntningarna kommer förmodligen se annorlunda ut."*

---
